facts.fact: Analyst Ernest Tarpeh writes that President Boakai signed the Cybercrime Act into law in 2026, giving courts the tools to prosecute offenders.

Analyst Ernest Tarpeh writes that the Data Protection Act creates an Independent Information Commissioner to guard citizen privacy; no appointment is reported.

facts.fact: Analyst Ernest Tarpeh writes that Liberia relies almost entirely on a single undersea fibre-optic cable, the ACE cable landing in Monrovia, for its international internet connection, with no backup routes.

facts.fact: Analyst Ernest Tarpeh writes that people in Liberia transfer mobile money at local market stalls and that mobile money networks run on the national connection.

Analyst Ernest Tarpeh writes that Liberians pay taxes through customs portals and that the Liberia Revenue Authority runs tax administration, electronic customs declarations and automated business filings.
